scope: Instances of the Becoming core's copying laws in the constructed copy machines. Structural copying: one machine move is one core move with first draw 1 and local draws; a template strand is copied exactly when the pool holds each token as often as the strand uses it and the support covers the draws, and released exactly when it also covers one unit, for every pool; the old support law is the instance with the template's tokens in the pool; every strand of a batch from one pool is released exactly when the pool supplies them together and the support covers all draws and releases, kept under adjacent exchange; every reproduction of a lineage of n is released exactly when the pool holds each token n times as often as the strand uses it and the support covers n times its draws and release, exactly when the support used is n times that, the converse of finite_lineage_inherits (on the strands alone it is false); the ranking and the third-strand constraint are instances of the local-draw laws. Chain growth: end attachment is the core copy of the alternating word with unit draws; the mature chain forms exactly when the pool holds at least four of each kind and eight units are free; attachment keeps the bonds the path on the tokens, so both hold bonds included; n rounds from k mature chains reach k * 2 ^ n exactly when the support covers 9 * required n k, exactly when the core doubling process with draw 9 runs. Registration: operating extends the product by a word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; complete registration is the instance; every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens, so complete registration copies the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path; the product only grows; only copy moves change it; the totals are kept. Correction: inspection never increases the defects for any copy exactly when the reference agrees with the template at the site; scans of such sites never increase them; the single-site criterion is an instance; the old wrong reference is unfaithful at the inspected site. Correspondence of these machines to molecular copying, proofreading or growth is not checked.
